'''June 2000 Tempe tournament (17 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Tempe, Arizona on 17 June 2000. It is known from Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d913">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-19-tempe-az-6-17-00d913/ tempe-az-6-17-00], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 19 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-19-tempe-az-6-17-00d913/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Tempe, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
